title: Framework PR #30 adds SonarQube Cloud new-code duplication in shared safety controls
title_de: Framework-PR #30 fügt SonarQube-Cloud-Duplikation in gemeinsamen Sicherheitskontrollen hinzu
summary: SonarQube Cloud initially reported 182 new duplicated lines (1.1771554233232002%, displayed as 1.2%) on Framework PR #30. The first behavior-preserving refactor reduced a historical exact head to 32 lines (0.2059732234809475%) with Quality Gate OK. The refreshed exact head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194 now reports Quality Gate OK, new_duplicated_lines=0, and new_duplicated_lines_density=0.0 with all applicable local controls and hosted checks passing. The finding is fixed on the verified PR head; master integration is not authorized in this task.
summary_de: SonarQube Cloud meldete auf Framework-PR #30 zunächst 182 neue duplizierte Zeilen (1.1771554233232002 %, angezeigt als 1.2 %). Die erste verhaltensbewahrende Refaktorierung reduzierte einen historischen Exact Head bei Quality Gate OK auf 32 Zeilen (0.2059732234809475 %). Der aktualisierte exakte Head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194 meldet nun Quality Gate OK, new_duplicated_lines=0 und new_duplicated_lines_density=0.0 bei bestandenen anwendbaren lokalen Controls und Hosted Checks. Der Befund ist auf dem verifizierten PR-Head fixed; eine Master-Integration ist in dieser Aufgabe nicht autorisiert.
observed_behavior: The initial PR #30 component measure reported new_lines=15461, new_duplicated_lines=182, and density=1.1771554233232002 across seven files. After the first normal push, the exact ce6c1570d3dfbe4b4da5f9560068c37a807899d3 head reports new_duplicated_lines=32 and new_duplicated_lines_density=0.2059732234809475 with alert_status=OK. File-level residual attribution is 14 lines in ci/reporting/generate-case-matrix.py and 18 in tests/security_regression/test_modsecurity_v3_git_ref_provenance.py. Sonar pairs the case-matrix blocks at lines 2947-3021 and 3146-3220 (75 lines each) and pairs the V3 assertion sequence with test_crs_git_ref_provenance.py lines 221-237. The residual is not a zero result and therefore does not satisfy the requested integration criterion.
observed_behavior_de: Die anfängliche PR-#30-Komponentenmetrik meldete new_lines=15461, new_duplicated_lines=182 und density=1.1771554233232002 über sieben Dateien. Nach dem ersten normalen Push meldet der exakte Head ce6c1570d3dfbe4b4da5f9560068c37a807899d3 new_duplicated_lines=32 und new_duplicated_lines_density=0.2059732234809475 mit alert_status=OK. Die Restzuordnung auf Dateiebene beträgt 14 Zeilen in ci/reporting/generate-case-matrix.py und 18 in tests/security_regression/test_modsecurity_v3_git_ref_provenance.py. Sonar paart die Case-Matrix-Blöcke bei Zeilen 2947-3021 und 3146-3220 (je 75 Zeilen) und paart die V3-Assertion-Sequenz mit test_crs_git_ref_provenance.py Zeilen 221-237. Der Rest ist kein Null-Ergebnis und erfüllt deshalb das verlangte Integrationskriterium nicht.
expected_behavior: The updated PR must retain all path traversal, symlink, directory-descriptor, temporary-file, atomic-replacement, provenance, and protocol assertions while using one reviewed implementation per shared behavior. Its exact current head must report zero new duplicated lines and 0.0% new duplicated-line density without changing SonarQube Cloud configuration, exclusions, thresholds, coverage, suppressions, or quality gates.
expected_behavior_de: Der aktualisierte PR muss alle Assertions zu Path-Traversal, Symlinks, Directory-Deskriptoren, temporären Dateien, atomarem Ersetzen, Provenance und Protokoll bewahren, während er je gemeinsamem Verhalten eine geprüfte Implementierung nutzt. Sein exakter aktueller Head muss ohne Änderung von SonarQube-Cloud-Konfiguration, Exclusions, Grenzwerten, Coverage, Suppressions oder Quality Gates null neue duplizierte Zeilen und 0.0 % New-Duplicated-Line-Density melden.
impact: Duplicated security-sensitive helpers can drift in rejection order, error handling, file-descriptor lifetime, or confinement semantics. The direct current impact is a user-blocking PR maintainability and quality result, not a validated exploitable vulnerability. The affected control paths require behavior-preserving extraction and negative-control regression tests.
impact_de: Duplizierte sicherheitssensitive Helfer können bei Ablehnungsreihenfolge, Fehlerbehandlung, File-Descriptor-Lebensdauer oder Confinement-Semantik auseinanderdriften. Die direkte aktuelle Auswirkung ist ein vom Nutzer blockierter PR-Maintainability- und Quality-Befund, keine validierte ausnutzbare Schwachstelle. Die betroffenen Control-Pfade erfordern eine verhaltensbewahrende Extraktion und Negative-Control-Regressionstests.
preconditions: Framework PR #30 remains open from fix/sonarcloud-quality-gate to master.
The measured pre-update head is b6af3ec83011b2070f6bbe4b3f471478b373f055.
The first remediated and normally pushed PR head is ce6c1570d3dfbe4b4da5f9560068c37a807899d3; it remains insufficient until a later exact head has zero duplication.
The SonarQube Cloud PR analysis is available for Easton97-Jens_ModSecurity-test-Framework pull request 30.

evidence.command: GitHub exact-head check-run/review readback and SonarQube Cloud PR #30 Quality Gate and measure queries; retained sanitized summary
evidence.summary: Normal merge commit a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194 has the prior PR head and current Framework master 3d6f51a2a2eeff6f3bcecff203f1e6ed1e240e4f as parents. Its exact PR #30 SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate is OK with new_duplicated_lines=0 and new_duplicated_lines_density=0.0; all terminal non-skipped GitHub checks, including CodeQL C/C++, succeeded.

root_cause: The historical PR added equivalent hardened path/runtime-root and secure report-writing routines independently in multiple producer scripts, rather than placing their common semantics in a reviewed shared utility. The normal master merge and first extraction removed most of that duplication. The exact residual consists of two semantically identical case-matrix runtime-snapshot sections and an immutable-commit provenance assertion sequence shared by V3 and CRS tests. The remaining extraction must preserve rendering order, evidence rows, no-clone/no-submodule assertions, and all negative cases.
root_cause_de: Der historische PR fügte gleichwertige gehärtete Pfad-/Runtime-Root- und sichere Report-Schreibroutinen unabhängig in mehreren Producer-Skripten hinzu, statt ihre gemeinsame Semantik in einem geprüften Shared Utility abzulegen. Der normale Master-Merge und die erste Extraktion beseitigten den Großteil dieser Duplikation. Der exakte Rest besteht aus zwei semantisch identischen Case-Matrix-Runtime-Snapshot-Abschnitten und einer Assertion-Sequenz für unveränderliche Commit-Provenance, die V3- und CRS-Tests gemeinsam haben. Die verbleibende Extraktion muss Rendering-Reihenfolge, Evidence-Zeilen, No-Clone-/No-Submodule-Assertions und alle Negativfälle bewahren.
proposed_remediation: Keep the first shared-utility refactor unchanged and complete only the two exact residuals: extract one pure case-matrix runtime-snapshot section appender with an ordering regression test, and extract one immutable-commit fetch-control assertion helper used by the distinct V3 and CRS legitimate-control tests. Do not alter the V3/CRS fake-Git fixtures or their unique negative controls. Run targeted controls, full lint, a focused staged security-diff review, then require fresh exact-head Sonar evidence of zero new duplication before normal squash merge.
proposed_remediation_de: Die erste Shared-Utility-Refaktorierung unverändert lassen und nur die zwei exakten Reste abschließen: einen reinen Case-Matrix-Runtime-Snapshot-Section-Appender mit Ordnungs-Regressionstest extrahieren und einen Assertion-Helper für unveränderliche Commit-Fetch-Controls verwenden, den die getrennten V3- und CRS-Legitimate-Control-Tests nutzen. Die V3/CRS-Fake-Git-Fixtures oder ihre einzigartigen Negativ-Controls nicht ändern. Gezielte Controls, vollständiges Linting und einen fokussierten gestagten Security-Diff-Review ausführen und danach frische Exact-Head-Sonar-Evidence mit null neuer Duplikation vor dem normalen Squash-Merge verlangen.
acceptance_criteria: A normal merge of current Framework master into the PR #30 lineage is completed without force-push or history rewrite.
Only the confirmed duplicated blocks, direct tests, and the existing bilingual PR #30 Change Record change after conflict resolution.
Path traversal, symlink, secure temporary-file, atomic replacement, provenance, and protocol negative controls remain exercised and passing.
The exact PR #30 head reports new_duplicated_lines=0 and new_duplicated_lines_density=0.0 in SonarQube Cloud, with Quality Gate OK.
No SonarQube Cloud rule, quality gate, threshold, baseline, exclusion, coverage setting, suppression, or NOSONAR marker is changed.
The exact reviewed PR head passes applicable hosted checks and is then merged normally into Framework master.
validation_plan: Inspect the normal master-merge diff and resolve each conflict by preserving both hardening paths; verify MRTS remains unchanged.

Run the focused producer and security-regression tests, protocol-client tests if that module changes, workflow-contract tests, targeted Python compilation, git diff --check, and applicable linting with task-owned output roots.
Perform a focused security-diff review of path, symlink, descriptor, atomic-write, source-provenance, and protocol-control changes.
After non-forced push, verify exact local, remote, and PR head equality; re-query Sonar measures, file-level duplication, Quality Gate, issues/hotspots, reviews, and CI checks for that exact head.
After authorized normal squash merge, read back the resulting master SHA and applicable master checks without changing the Parent gitlink or MRTS.
legitimate_control_tests: Existing tests that reject traversal, symlink components, unsafe runtime roots, and unsafe temporary-file conditions remain passing.
Existing provenance and protocol assertions continue to distinguish permitted legitimate inputs from rejected cases.
The shared report writer preserves secure descriptor-relative creation, atomic replacement, and failure behavior.
The refactor produces zero new SonarQube Cloud duplicate lines without any analytical-control workaround.
dependencies: A clean isolated task-owned Framework worktree
Exact-head GitHub Actions and SonarQube Cloud analyses
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-SONAR-0002. FND-SONAR-0002 owns the pre-existing Framework-master multi-file Quality Gate backlog and its scoped historical risk decision. This finding owns the distinct, currently reproducible PR #30 new-code duplication and its behavior-preserving source/test remediation.
evidence_limitations: SonarQube Cloud duplication groups expose duplicated blocks but not the individual new-line subset within overlapping groups.
The exact metric must be re-read for the final pushed PR head; the retained record proves the pre-remediation state only.
Framework master has an independent historical Sonar backlog under FND-SONAR-0002; it is neither a cause of this PR result nor automatically waived for this task.
residual_risk: The original PR-specific duplication no longer reproduces on exact head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194, and the required controls passed without a Sonar workaround. This finding remains fixed rather than verified because the current user did not authorize Framework-master integration or resulting-master revalidation. The separate FND-SONAR-0002 master backlog remains outside this finding and is not accepted here.
residual_risk_de: Die ursprüngliche PR-spezifische Duplikation reproduziert auf dem exakten Head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194 nicht mehr, und die erforderlichen Controls bestanden ohne Sonar-Workaround. Dieser Befund bleibt fixed statt verified, weil der aktuelle Nutzer keine Framework-master-Integration oder Resulting-Master-Revalidation autorisiert hat. Der separate FND-SONAR-0002-Master-Backlog liegt außerhalb dieses Befunds und wird hier nicht akzeptiert.
